title: pltfm-ops-sprint-handoff-cafeteria-brief
content:
Cafeteria-style sprint handoff notes — Platform Engineering (control plane / routing / auth / quotas)
Meeting: weekly sprint handoff (informal) — 2027-11-18 09:30-10:00 PT
Attendees: Maya Chen (owner), Diego Alvarez, Priya Rao, Owen Patel, Lin Zhao, optional: SRE on-call (Ana)
Purpose: quick, consumable handoff for the incoming rotation; capture open action items, short-term risks, and experiment notes. This is intentionally terse — for detailed tickets see linked artifacts.

1) Quick headlines
- Control plane: new shard resync logic (PLAT-1987) is in staging and showing ~8% CPU reduction; still need canary across two clusters.
- Routing: fallback policy change merged in infra repo, but we saw a regression with per-tenant sticky routing when sequence-length > 8k tokens — rollback scheduled if smoke fails.
- Auth: short-lived token refresh edge-case: refresh race on multi-call sessions (reported by CS) — hotfix branch created.
- Quotas: fairness experiment v2 (adaptive throttling by request entropy) started collecting data; observed 3% reduction in tail latency for high-throughput tenants.

2) Control plane (Maya)
- Status: PLAT-1987 (shard resync deterministic backoff) merged to staging; running rolling canary on staging-A. Observed fewer resync storms after 48h.
- Risks: on-prem customers with slower disks may trigger longer resync windows; need a knob to disable prefetching.
- Action: add prefetch_disable flag to controlplane config and push config draft to ops repo (owner: Maya, due: 2027-11-22).
- Note to on-call: watch for repeating resync logs (resync_start/resync_end every < 30m). If seen, escalate to controlplane-eng channel.

3) Routing (Diego)
- Status: fallback policy change (GH: infra/routing#278) merged to canary; results look good for <1M qps. Canary on region us-west-2 will expand tomorrow at 02:00 UTC.
- Incident: observed per-tenant sticky mismatch when long-context sessions hit an overflow path (repro steps in PLAT-2001). Temporary mitigation: limit context-split to 6k tokens for sticky-policy tenants.
- Action items: revert sticky-policy change if canary shows mismatch on expansion (owner: Diego, revert window: 2027-11-19 08:00-12:00 PT). Add unit test for sticky routing on long sequences (owner: Owen).

4) Auth (Priya)
- Status: token refresh race: race occurs when a single client refreshes token while parallel requests are inflight; root cause traced to cache invalidation timing. Hotfix branch priya/auth-token-fix created and running integration smoke.
- Customer impact: small subset of web clients report 401s during refresh; CS ticket CS-554 prioritized.
- Action: backport hotfix to dedicated v1.8 (owner: Priya, target: 2027-11-20). Notify support and include workaround (client exponential backoff) in CS reply.

5) Quotas (Owen & Lin)
- Status: fairness experiment v2 (adaptive throttling) is sampling on 12 tenants. Early metrics: token savings ~6% on bursty tenants, tail latency down ~3% for affected endpoints.
- Concern: metric noise — need to expand sample to 30 tenants before concluding. Also see latency spike correlated with one tenant's background replay workload.
- Action: expand to cohort B (owner: Lin, rollout date 2027-11-23). Add dashboard panel: 'quota-adaptive: tenant replay overlap' (owner: Owen). Create alert if overlap > 0.2 for > 10m.

6) Incidents / on-call notes
- Yesterday 03:12 UTC: auth 401 spike for refresh flows — mitigated by rate limiting a misbehaving client (CS-554). Root cause in ticket.
- 2027-11-16 21:40 PT: routing mismatch reported for tenant-879 (investigated by Diego) — merged mitigation.
- On-call TODO: run token-refresh smoke after deploys to auth hotfix; check controlplane resync log frequency every 4h for next 48h.

7) Blockers and dependencies
- Storage team: need confirmation on prefetch_disable semantics for on-prem agent (contact: Rajiv).
- Security review: auth hotfix needs sign-off for dedicated customers before backport; Priya to ping security (ticket: SEC-3304).
- Dedicated infra quota: awaiting capacity allocation for staggered canary in eu-west-1 (ticket PLAT-2010).

8) Open questions and brainstorm snippets (raw/untamed)
- Should we expose 'adaptive quota as beta' flag per-tenant in Console for easier opt-in? Pros: faster feedback; Cons: support overhead.
- What is the expected behavior for sticky routing when sequences are truncated vs split? Might want a spec doc that enumerates the desired invariant. (Action: Maya to draft short spec).
- Could we detect long-context sessions earlier and route to a 'long-context pool' to avoid sticky-policy mismatch? Experiment idea: header hint or early token-count precheck in gateway.

9) Action item summary (short)
- Maya: add prefetch_disable config + PR to ops (due 2027-11-22).
- Diego: monitor canary expansion, revert window on 2027-11-19 if mismatch (owner: Diego).
- Owen: add sticky routing unit tests for long sequences (due 2027-11-21).
- Priya: backport auth hotfix to dedicated v1.8 and coordinate security sign-off (due 2027-11-20).
- Lin: expand quotas cohort to 30 tenants, create dashboard panel and alert (rollout 2027-11-23).

10) Misc notes / scratchpad (choppy)
- quick TODO: remind PM to update release notes text for auth hotfix (short blurb).
- note: we should add a small blurb in ops-runbook about quota adaptive experiment (where to mute alerts).
- "notes to self" — check with infra-scheduler about canary time windows overlap with other teams next Thurs.

11) Next sync
- Informal quick sync scheduled: 2027-11-22 09:30 PT (15 min) — primarily to preview canary expansion and confirm action progress.

End of brief.

-- Maya
(If you're reading this offline: add quick comments inline or ping #pltfm-ops for urgent handoffs.)
